title: AgentLeak: privacy-leakage testing for agentic AI systems
description: AgentLeak audits a complete agent execution trace for privacy leakage across eight channels — user input, tool calls, tool responses, shared memory, inter-agent messages, logs, generated files and the final answer — and scores it deterministically. An agent can return a clean answer while private data leaves through a channel nobody reads; across the 283 scenarios bundled with the tool, every leak behaves that way. Scoring uses exact ground-truth matching rather than a judge model, so the same trace always yields the same number.
